ArenaLab update v1
version: 1.1.0
note: Automatic updates: the app now knows where to look for them.
note: Ring aprons can be edited one by one, each on its own side.
note: The Preload apron can be left blank.
note: Turnbuckles: the own/vanilla switch is no longer lost on redraw.
note: Matchups: with line breaking on, the frame on the canvas is the text box. Its sides are where the line breaks and they can be dragged; the corners still scale the letters. Box width and height can also be typed in.
note: Matchups: the app now names the font a project asks for even when you do not have it extracted, and says the preview is a stand-in.
note: The tool buttons no longer overlap each other.
